about: 70 support questions written by Smarter.codes, with the evidence a complete retrieval must find. Primary evidence is what the answer cannot do without; supporting evidence helps. A unit with several chunk_ids is one clause split across chunks: finding any of them counts. A retrieved passage matches a unit when it comes from the same document and contains one of its quotes (whitespace ignored). chunk_ids refer to the reference index (277 chunks); scoring uses only document and quote.
